units: Gen. VI, 5) = י׳ מחשבות the formation of thoughts, bent of mind, inclination, desire.—י׳ הטוב or י׳ טוב (abbr. יה״ט or י״ט) the good nature of man, the inclination to do good; (personified) the good genius; י׳ הרע (abbrev. יצה״ר), also only י׳ the evil inclination, worldly desires; (personified) the tempter.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:7">Gen. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11:3">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>אילולי יצה״ר לא בנה וכ׳</he> but for the worldly desires of man, none would build a house &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:11">Ab. II, 11</cite> <he>עין הרע ויצה״ר וכ׳</he> greed, sensual passion and hatred &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 103a:13">Snh. 103ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 842:10">Yalk. Ps. 842</cite> <he>שלא ישלוט בך יצה״ר</he> that temptation may have no power over thee.
<cite ref="Sukkah 52a:1">Succ. 52ᵃ</cite> … <he>לעתיד מביאו ליצה״ר וכ׳</he> in the days to come the Lord shall bring the Tempter and slaughter him &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:6">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>מפנק את יִצְרוֹ</he> who indulges the senses.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אם בא יִצְרְךָ להשחיקך</he> when thy inclination (Tempter) comes to lead thee to amusement.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8:1">Cant. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>י׳ ע״ז</he> the passion for idolatry, <he>י׳ זנות</he> the passion of lust.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:1">Ab. IV, 1</cite> <he>הכובש את יצרו</he> who conquers his inclination; a. v. fr. [<cite ref="Yoma 69b:15">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite> <he>כובש את יצרו</he>, read with Ms. M. <he>כעסו</he>.]—Pl. <he>יְצָרִים</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:3">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>וייצר</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:7">Gen. II, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00538"><he>יְצִירָה</he></cite>) <he>שני י׳ וכ׳</he> two natures, the good and the evil. Cant. R. l. c. <he>שני י׳ ברא וכ׳</he> two passions did God create in this world, v. supra.
Snh. 105ᵃ יסרו יצריכם chasten your passions; Yalk. Is. 302.—[יְצָרִים moulds, v. יְצִירִין.]
